title: UI: a 'Hide Library Badges' setting, wired to itself
description: Adds the com.exedock.hideLibraryBadges AppStorage flag and a real 'Hide Library Badges' toggle in DefaultSettingsSheet, with full controller D-pad/A-button focus wiring matching the existing Show Floating Steam Icon toggle. The flag exists and is user-controllable now; nothing reads it to actually hide anything yet - that's a separate, later piece.
commit_message: Add Hide Library Badges setting (flag + toggle UI)
